prompt: You left the invoice for morning. A coworker pays it overnight.

choices.label: Waiting meant nobody could pay it.
The request was still in the box.
Morning is the same as calling.

prompt: The vendor name matches. The address gained one letter.

choices.label: The name is the part that matters.

prompt: He watched the upload and repeated the folder path.

choices.label: The work will be filed as his.
The work will be filed as yours.

prompt: The free site shows a link with no names on it.

choices.label: Only your coworker can open it.

prompt: The log shows the found badge used after it was reported lost.

choices.label: A found badge is still a badge.
